info.title: TokenHub API
info.description: Actual new application contract. Direct API paths start /v1. Browser reverse proxy paths start /api/v1 and strip /api before Gin. Customer and staff use HttpOnly tokenhub_session; model API uses a brand-bound Bearer Key. All money/ATG amounts are exact decimal strings. Domain ownership, permission and business state are enforced server-side. This contract covers all model endpoints and core browser flows; operator commands use explicit request schemas derived from the actual typed workflows and reviewed technical DTOs.
